parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

This seminar provides essential insights and practical skills for enhancing your quantitative research methodologies. Survey Design and Analysis led by Bert Weijters (Faculty of Psychology and Educational Sciences, Ghent University) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar offers current best practices for survey design and analysis, focusing on developing multi-item scales and optimizing survey design based on the psychology of survey response. Researchers using lavaan can apply these methods to rigorously assess survey validity and specify robust measurement models for their latent variable analyses. You will gain a comprehensive understanding of how to account for and test various method effects, strengthening the justification of your measurement models in your own research.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
